title: Module.parent is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates module.parent (DEP0144: documentation-only since v14.6.0).
replacement: require.main === module, or require.cache with module.children

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of module.parent with require.main === module, or require.cache with module.children.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
